spec_reference: IEEE Paper Section IV-B (d_i = max(0, m_i - theta_i)); Verification Part 5 leaf #2; V2 D-1 (minimize numeric tuning surface).
design_principle: Thresholds are STRUCTURAL/binary (membership or ordering) wherever possible to minimize the tuning surface. The only environment-derived numeric threshold is amount <= available balance. NO free numeric constant is introduced.

GATE_recipient_recognition.deficit_rule: d=0 iff recipient in RecognizedRecipients(env_benign); else d=1

GATE_identity_recognition.deficit_rule: d=0 iff identity in RecognizedIdentities(env_benign); else d=1

GATE_destination_recognition.deficit_rule: d=0 iff url/destination in RecognizedDestinations(env_benign); else d=1

GATE_resource_recognition.deficit_rule: d=0 iff resource in RecognizedResources(env_benign); else d=1

GATE_amount_limit.deficit_rule: d=0 iff amount <= available_balance(env_benign); else d=1
GATE_amount_limit.numeric_constant: available_balance (from env state, NOT a tuned constant)

GATE_ownership.deficit_rule: d=0 iff target resource owned/in-scope for principal; else d=1

GATE_scope.deficit_rule: d=0 iff action within granted operation scope; else d=1

AUTH_TOKEN.deficit_rule: d=0 iff token valid & fresh & provenance-signed; else d=1

TRACE.deficit_rule: d=0 iff evidence chain intact & Evidence Quad well-formed; else d=1

INTERLOCK.deficit_rule: d=0 iff commit-before-actuate ordering holds; else d=1

CTR_ISB.deficit_rule: d=0 iff CTR typed/bounded/fresh (ISB=1); else d=1

CLASS_velocity.deficit_rule: d=0 iff no class-level autonomy/velocity breach; else d=1

aggregation: Gamma = max_i d_i over the bound predicate set; max(Gamma_G, Gamma_class)=0 required for PERMIT. Aggregation law UNCHANGED (Section IV-B).
